Description
Mercure London Bankside
Hotel for travellers looking for local and authentic experiences
Mercure London Bankside proudly stands as the flagship Mercure hotel within the cultural heart of London, Bankside. Nestled in this lively area, it offers close proximity to renowned attractions such as Tate Modern, Shakespeare's Globe, Borough Market, Southbank and the St Paul's Cathedral, all easily accessible. Upon entering the hotel. enjoy the homely atmosphere or why not try our French hospitality in Bistro Mirlot offering authentic French gastronomy and wines.
As part of our dedicated commitment to sustainability, we are thrilled to introduce complimentary water refill stations installed in each floor. This initiative provides a convenient and environmentally friendly alternative to single use plastic bottles. Demonstrating our ongoing dedication, we have successfully eliminated all single use plastic items from the guest experience, promoting a more environmentally responsible stay.
Whether you're exploring London for leisure or visiting for business, make your stay memorable at Mercure London Bankside. See more Mercure London Bankside
Hotel information
Collectively, these endeavours highlight our steadfast dedication to sustainability and continual endeavours to foster a beneficial influence on the environment and the communities we cater to. Encounter the fusion of cosiness, allure, and eco-awareness at Mercure London Bankside, where your welfare and the planet take centre stage in our hospitality approach.
Hotel extras
Green Key Certified Hotel
Central London Location with Easy Access to St. Paul's, Tate Modern, London Eye & Waterloo
144 Modern Guest Rooms with Connecting Rooms Available for Families On Request
3 Fully Equipped Meeting Rooms with Free Unlimited Wi-Fi
Pet Friendly hotel - allowed in common areas. Service dogs welcome without any restrictions

BISTRO MIRLOT
See details
Bistro Mirlot is a contemporary French bistro offering a locally inspired menu and an exclusive selection of French wines, all served in a relaxed and stylish setting that blends rustic charm with modern elegance. See details
THE LOUNGE BAR
See details
With Bankside now one of the trendiest parts of London and home to a burgeoning foodie scene, The Loft Bar and glassed roof atrium presents an idyllic setting in which to enjoy our extensive wine menu. See details
Breakfast
See details
Breakfast is served from 6.30am to 10.00am Monday to Friday with extended service at weekends from 7am to 11.00am. Choose from Full English Breakfast and Continential options, with locally sourced products. See details

Our guest reviews

ALL Rating 4.6/5 1,447 reviews
Customer review rating 4.0/5
Lucy B. Business
- 11/5/2026 Confirmed reviews ALL
Staff were all super helpful, friendly and efficient.
My accessible room was very spacious and easy to manoeuvre around in.
Bedroom was clean, modern and quiet, despite it being on the ground floor.
Breakfast was very good - plenty of selection, and again super-friendly and helpful staff.
Will definitely be returning! ***** See more See more about the review from Lucy B.
Our hotel has responded to the review Our hotel has responded to the review from Lucy B.
Dear Lucy,
Thank you for sharing your wonderful experience at Mercure London Bankside. We are delighted to hear that you appreciated our great location, friendly staff, and comfortable accommodations. It is especially gratifying to know that your accessible room met your needs and that you enjoyed our breakfast selection. We look forward to welcoming you back for another enjoyable stay.
Best regards,
Ola - Reception Manager

Customer review rating 4.0/5
Michael P. Families
- 11/1/2026 Confirmed reviews ALL
As usual the overall trio was more than satisfactory but unfortunately on Sunday morning the breakfast offerings were short of their usual levels. The pastries, yoghurts and at least 2 of the hot offerings were not available for the whole time we were in the restaurant area. I did raise this but nothing much changed though I believe some pasties did arrive as we were leaving. We arrived for breakfast at around 9:15 so not near the end of the serving time. This is an exception and the usual offering is more than adequate, this is reason we always book breakfast during our stays. See more See more about the review from Michael P.
Our hotel has responded to the review Our hotel has responded to the review from Michael P.
Dear Michael,
Thank you for your feedback regarding your recent stay. We are pleased to hear that your overall experience was satisfactory; however, we apologize for the inconvenience you encountered during breakfast on Sunday. We appreciate your continued patronage and look forward to welcoming you back soon.
Kind regards,
Mercedesz
Front Office Team Leader
Customer review rating 3.5/5
Richard B. Couples
- 10/31/2026 Confirmed reviews ALL
Staff very friendly and helpful. Did not like the mattress- far too soft and air con completely ineffective - glad we didn’t visit in the height of summer. See more See more about the review from Richard B.
Our hotel has responded to the review Our hotel has responded to the review from Richard B.
Dear Richard,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback following your recent stay with us.
We are delighted to hear that you found our location convenient and our team friendly and helpful.
We are sorry to hear that the mattress was not to your liking and that you experienced difficulties with the air conditioning.
Please note that we are now operating on our winter settings. During this period, the air conditioning system is set to heating mode and, when switched on, will only blow warm air. If you prefer a cooler room, we would recommend switching it off.
We appreciate your comments and will certainly take your feedback regarding the mattress into consideration.
Thank you once again for your feedback. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back in the future.
Best wishes,
Ola - Reception Manager
Customer review rating 4.0/5
Kaylah W. Business
- 10/30/2026 Confirmed reviews ALL
I was pleased with my stay. The breakfast was very nice each morning and the 12pm check out was much appreciated. Though it did not feel unclean, there were noticeable stains on the curtains and carpeting, which is why I did not give this hotel a higher rating. The staff were lovely and our experience truly was wonderful overall. See more See more about the review from Kaylah W.
Our hotel has responded to the review Our hotel has responded to the review from Kaylah W.
Dear Kaylah W.,
Thank you for your kind words regarding your stay at our hotel. We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the breakfast and appreciated the late checkout. Your feedback about the curtains and carpeting is valuable, and we will take it into consideration for our ongoing improvements. We hope to welcome you back for another wonderful experience in the future.
Kind regards,
Cameron
